title: Rust parity: Rust missing CongestionLevel enum
description: Python has CongestionLevel (NORMAL/ELEVATED/CRITICAL/EXHAUSTED) per spec 07 §10.2.3. Rust DutyCycleTracker only tracks budget without congestion states. Fix: add CongestionLevel enum and state machine.
close_reason: Fixed: Added CongestionLevel enum (Normal/Elevated/Critical/Exhausted) with spec 07 thresholds (50/80/95%), congestion_level_from_permille(), CongestionState struct, CongestionError, check_congestion_allows(), and tracker methods congestion_level()/congestion_state(). All 33 tests pass.
